title: Handoff packet
description: What an agent hands a person when it stops. The packet is checked: complete only when a person could act without asking the agent anything.

import { checkHandoff, type Handoff } from './handoff' import { cx, formatWhen } from './util' export type HandoffPacketProps = { title: string /** What the agent handed over. Anything missing is shown as missing, not hidden. */ handoff: Partial now?: string | Date className?: string } const left = (ms: number) => { const m = Math.round(Math.abs(ms) / 60000) const t = m < 60 ? `${m} min` : `${Math.floor(m / 60)} h ${String(m % 60).padStart(2, '0')} min` return ms < 0 ? `${t} past the deadline` : `${t} to act` } const Gap = ({ what }: { what: string }) => Missing: {what} /** * What an agent hands a person when it stops. The packet is checked, not trusted: a handoff is complete only when a * person could act without asking the agent anything, and every part that is missing is named. */ export function HandoffPacket({ title, handoff: h, now, className }: HandoffPacketProps) { const c = checkHandoff(h, now) return (
